_what: Where the separated architecture would act, on the sewer layer the city actually has.
_measured: Catchment class, plan, impervious area, person equivalents and plant are the municipal sewer-catchment layer. Outfall type and basin volume are the national RBU register. Basins are the city's cloudburst projects.
_proposed: The polder outline and the pond cells are schematic. Nothing in this project has surveyed them.

classes.foul_only: Sewage only - rain is already elsewhere
classes.separate: Separated: roof and road water to a receiving water
classes.separate_road: Separated: road water to a receiving water
classes.three_pipe: Three pipes: sewage, roof water and road water apart
